t: Picture book lessons that pair stories with VEX 123 robot coding for PreK to grade 5.
steps: Find the Books and Bots page from Nevada Robotics.
Email nvrobotics@dri.edu to ask about a training session.
Attend a Books and Bots training if one is near you.
Ask about the lending library for VEX 123 robots.
Gather the lesson books and a VEX 123 robot.
Send the School-Home Connection handout home after the lesson.
